{{Top|leg}}
The '''Strength package''' increased the user's strength without the need for additional muscle mass through a combination of regulating [[Brain/Legends|brain]] stem functions and small doses of [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenal]] [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, the playable character must have a constitution attribute of 12 or higher.
